_brief: V2 (Tal on V1, 2026-10-04: "use the Erez V1 skill for this video, it s so bad the way you did this one" - LESSONS 86). Recut on formats/erez-fast-cut.md after reading his reel DdynV0UMrtr at 30 fps (0-8.5s): wide -> 4-frame snap zoom -> tight hold drifting in -> hard cut; time only forward; one action one shot; Tal SEEN giving; reactions cut on emotion with the zoom on his face; slow-mo on the food arriving, the laugh and the final hold. No title, no grade, no emoji. One continuous ambience bed (bedOnly) with his real voice on the one captioned line. Tal s rule for this video: no passers-by through the tight frame - every window and crop was aimed on gridded stills. V1 (no zooms, 27.7s) kept: EK_HOMELESS2_VISUAL_V1.mp4 / edit-V1-no-zoom.json.

fast zoom in (4 frames) onto the two of them
SLOW-MO hold: he listens to Tal - end
